title: String Reversal Bug
problem: The function is supposed to reverse a string and return it, but it always returns the original string unchanged. Find and fix the bug.

title: Missing Recursion Base Case

title: Dictionary Key Error

title: Type Error: String + Integer

title: Wrong Maximum Logic
